summary: The focused Vitest and Playwright suites pass, but the story-local E2E evidence does not behaviorally prove delayed retry, note-only, hash-mismatch, and candidate write-back failure paths.

findings.detail: The executable coverage test checks scenario identifiers in a static array; it does not execute S-002, S-003, S-004 or FM-001 through FM-003.
The story requires user-visible transition evidence for note-only success, delayed async retry, and candidate write-back failure, but those assertions currently exist only at service-test level.
